thread:
support-jen: FYI escalation from acme-inc — their SIEM shows a gap: ~6k audit events missing for 2025-11-03 00:00-06:00 UTC. Manifests under audits/manifests look smaller than expected. sample event ids: evt_9a1b, evt_9a1c. Requesting help to triage.

support-jen: Repro steps I used: 1) GET /v1/audit/exports?tenant=acme-inc&start=2025-11-03T00:00Z&end=2025-11-03T06:00Z 2) list s3 prefix: s3://redwood-audit/audits/tenant=acme-inc/date=2025-11-03/ 3) download manifest: s3://redwood-audit/audits/manifests/2025-11-03-00.manifest.gz and compare object count vs expected 4) attempt to download one missing object id from manifest list.

support-jen: manifest snippet we pulled: ```{ "manifest_version": 1, "objects": ["audits/tenant=acme-inc/part-00000.gz","audits/tenant=acme-inc/part-00001.gz"], "object_count": 124 }```

security-raj: Do we have KMS/HSM decrypt failures or any forwarder logs showing skipped batches? Any records of zero-byte batches?

eng-storage: Quick check of storage logs shows a lifecycle change rolled out 2025-10-30 (rule id: archive-old-audits) that transitioned older audit objects to GLACIER_IR. The manifest generator currently excludes objects in non-'STANDARD' storage classes unless restored. That would explain missing objects from manifests.

support-jen: The customer insists they never requested archiving. Could the lifecycle policy have been applied cluster-wide by mistake? @eng-platform can you confirm?

eng-platform: Confirmed — the rollout targeted prefix audits/ globally. A tenant filter was misconfigured so it applied to multiple tenants including acme-inc. Apologies. We'll rollback the rule for active prefixes.

eng-storage: Two immediate actions: 1) initiate restores for the archived objects referenced by the time window (estimate ~25 objects, depends on archive tier) 2) after restore completes, regenerate manifests so they include restored objects. Restore ETA: 4-12 hours depending on tier (Bulk vs Standard).

security-raj: Checked KMS logs — no decrypt failures for these object keys. HSM key rotation completed 2025-10-29T21:00Z, but object re-encryption job did not run for archived objects. If objects were archived before rewrap/re-encrypt, we'll need to re-encrypt after restore. No evidence the forwarder skipped due to KMS errors.

support-jen: Customer also reports their SIEM shows ordering gaps after initial replay attempt. Hypothesis: manifests were regenerated without placeholders so SIEM saw fewer objects and dedup guards prevented re-ingest. Plan: restore objects -> re-encrypt if needed -> regenerate manifests with deterministic ordering -> coordinate replay window with SIEM.

customer-acct-rep: Notified acme POC, offered to cover restore costs as a goodwill credit. They've accepted; awaiting confirmation to proceed.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-20251103-17, PagerDuty notified.

security-raj: Opening a brief playbook in the incident doc: key commands and checks. Sample restore command to run: ```aws s3api restore-object --bucket redwood-audit --key audits/tenant=acme-inc/part-00012.gz --restore-request '{"Days":7,"GlacierJobParameters":{"Tier":"Bulk"}}'```

eng-storage: Also recommending a change: manifest generator should surface 'archived' placeholders instead of dropping entries silently. Filing INFRA-845 to track adding placeholder entries + telemetry so we don't get silent drops.

eng-platform: Rolling back lifecycle rule for active audit prefixes now. Will follow up once rollback is confirmed.

support-jen: Owners/assignments: eng-storage = restore + regenerate manifests; eng-platform = lifecycle rollback + rollouts review; security = verify re-encrypt/rewrap plan; support = customer comms + replay coordination. Will post first update in ~2 hours. :eyes: :+1:

security-raj: After restore/regeneration we'll run a small sample replay to SIEM (1 hour window) and verify counts and sequence ordering before full re-ingest.

support-jen: Logging notes/attachments in INC-20251103-17 — will attach manifest copies and S3 object list when available.
